name: kaiwa-scenes-01-05
description: 15 cảnh minh họa cho các tình huống hội thoại Bài 1 đến Bài 5.

jobs.subject: medium shot from the knees up inside a bright station-front cafe: a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, and a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, standing large in the foreground facing each other and exchanging slight polite bows as they meet for the first time; softly blurred simple cafe interior with plants behind them, no street, no bicycle.

alt.vi: Tanaka và Mai cúi chào làm quen trên con phố thị trấn.

jobs.subject: in a quiet university campus hallway, a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, gestures politely to introduce a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, to a Japanese university teacher, man about 55, short gray hair, thin round glasses, navy cardigan over light-blue collared shirt, calm kind smile; clean campus corridor with wooden bench and soft window light.

alt.vi: Mai giới thiệu Tanaka với thầy Mori ở hành lang trường đại học.

jobs.subject: inside a calm Japanese medical clinic consultation room, a Japanese male doctor about 40, short black hair, white coat, stethoscope around neck, sits at a wooden desk asking questions politely while a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, sits opposite answering; clean desk with blank medical chart and clipboard, no text.

alt.vi: Bác sĩ hỏi thông tin của Mai trong phòng khám.

jobs.subject: at an apartment entrance doorway in an apartment hallway, a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, hands a small wrapped gift box of Vietnamese coffee with both hands to a Japanese woman about 45, shoulder-length brown hair tied low, beige sweater, warm smile (neighbor), who receives it gladly; simple apartment doorway, plain door, warm lighting.

alt.vi: Mai tặng quà cà phê làm quen với chị hàng xóm Ookawa trước cửa nhà.

jobs.subject: in a quiet study room or library corner, a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, points inquiringly toward a thick book held by a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, who shows the blank cover of a dictionary and smiles explaining; wooden table with another blank book resting on it.

alt.vi: Tanaka và Mai trò chuyện về cuốn từ điển và sách trên bàn.

jobs.subject: in an entryway near an umbrella stand, a Japanese university teacher, man about 55, short gray hair, thin round glasses, navy cardigan over light-blue collared shirt, calm kind smile, points with a puzzled smile to a plain sage umbrella, while a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, and a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, stand beside him smiling and pointing out that the umbrella belongs to him; wooden shoe rack and umbrella stand, no text.

alt.vi: Thầy Mori hỏi về chiếc ô, Tanaka và Mai tươi cười chỉ chiếc ô của thầy.

jobs.subject: at a sleek wooden information and reception desk in a modern building lobby, a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, stands asking directions from a young Japanese receptionist woman, dark hair in a low bun, navy blazer, white blouse, who politely gestures toward the elevator corridor with an open hand; clean lobby background with elevator doors and no signs or text.

alt.vi: Mai hỏi đường nhân viên lễ tân tại quầy thông tin.

jobs.subject: inside a quiet department store menswear counter, a Japanese department-store clerk, man about 30, neat dark hair, dark vest, white shirt, plain tie, shows a neatly displayed patterned necktie on a wooden counter to a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, who looks at it thoughtfully; glass display case with folded ties and accessories, no price tags, no signs, no text.

alt.vi: Nhân viên bán hàng giới thiệu cà vạt cho Mai tại quầy bách hóa.

jobs.subject: on a city sidewalk or plaza, a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, points toward a modern office building in the distance while talking with a Japanese university teacher, man about 55, short gray hair, thin round glasses, navy cardigan over light-blue collared shirt, calm kind smile, and a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, who listen attentively; city street corner with tree and blank building facades.

alt.vi: Tanaka chỉ về phía tòa nhà công ty khi trò chuyện cùng thầy Mori và Mai.

jobs.subject: outside on a town sidewalk near a bank building with closed glass doors, a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, asks about the time while a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, checks a blank wristwatch on his wrist; on the wall in background, an analog clock with hands pointing to roughly three ten but with completely blank dial without numbers; no text, no signs.

alt.vi: Mai hỏi giờ anh Tanaka trước tòa nhà ngân hàng.

jobs.subject: in a warm cozy home living room, a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, holds a phone to her ear while sitting at a small wooden table taking notes on a blank notepad; soft window light, a small potted succulent and a mug on the table, no other person, no text or writing on the notepad.

alt.vi: Mai ngồi ở nhà gọi điện thoại hỏi thông tin.

jobs.subject: at a small table in a casual campus café or lounge, a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, and a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, sit facing each other with tea cups, talking warmly about their daily morning routines and study habits; gentle afternoon window light, cozy wooden chairs, no text.

alt.vi: Tanaka và Mai trò chuyện về thói quen sinh hoạt mỗi ngày.

jobs.subject: on a Japanese train station concourse near the platform gate, a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, speaks with a Japanese station attendant man about 35, navy uniform jacket and cap without any logo or text, who politely gestures toward the platform stairs to indicate the train direction; train platform structure in background, blank overhead destination boards with no numbers, no letters, no text.

alt.vi: Mai hỏi nhân viên nhà ga về chuyến tàu đi Koshien.

jobs.subject: on a tree-lined town street beside a bicycle rack, a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, and a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, stand chatting cheerfully about their weekend plans; a simple parked bicycle nearby, pleasant sunny day, green trees and distant shop awnings without text.

alt.vi: Tanaka và Mai trò chuyện về kế hoạch đi chơi cuối tuần.

jobs.subject: in a university lounge or classroom corner, a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top, gentle smile, smiles happily as she talks about her birthday and upcoming family museum trip with a young Japanese man about 25, short slightly messy dark hair, ivory long-sleeve shirt, friendly smile, and a Japanese university teacher, man about 55, short gray hair, thin round glasses, navy cardigan over light-blue collared shirt, calm kind smile, who both listen with warm smiles; wooden table, wall with a blank calendar or blank art poster in background, no text.

alt.vi: Mai hào hứng kể với Tanaka và thầy Mori về ngày sinh nhật và chuyến đi bảo tàng cùng gia đình.
